spec.prereg: GEOMAG-ONSET-CSD (critical-slowing-down early-warning, 12-24h pre-storm-onset, directed, theory-anchor, same anchor as IMS-CSD/CALCE-CSD)
spec.domain: USGS geomag 1Hz X component, observatories BOU+FRD

event_definition.onset: Kp[t]>=5 & Kp[t-1]<5 & max(Kp[t-8:t])<5 (24h clean baseline, G1+)
event_definition.quiet: >=48h consecutive Kp<3 run, reference = 30h into run
event_definition.subsample: stride pick, target N=20 each (geomag_fresh.pickdays idiom)

params.axis_pin: test1 uses col 2*b (axis x); test2/3 col b

spec.statistic: ims_csd._csd_bearing(hi) UNCHANGED: Kendall tau of rolling ar1(t)/logvar(t) of Gaussian-detrended residual
spec.significance: per window, Fourier phase-randomized surrogate x N_surr (ims_csd params); 1-sided p
spec.primary: per obs: CSD+ rate (tau_ar1>0 & p_ar1<alpha & tau_var>0 & p_var<alpha) onset > quiet; Fisher exact greater
spec.specificity: quiet windows must not fire at the onset rate
spec.confound_guard: ar1-rise reported separately from var-rise; CONFIRMED needs BOTH
spec.honest_n_gate: if n_onset_valid < 15 after fetch drops -> verdict forced INSUFFICIENT-N (per obs)
spec.claim_scope: ground X-component fluctuation dynamics, 12-24h pre-onset, BOU+FRD only
